definition: Shrinkage uses zero-intercept constrained training-pair regression of centered outgoing on incoming delay and the corresponding empirical residual law. Heavy-tail uses independent route-centered incoming/outgoing role-noise KDEs plus a common zero-location Cauchy day effect; the incoming residual updates the day-effect posterior. Cauchy scale is the unscaled MAD of training-pair incoming residuals about their training median. No development value selects a parameter.
numerics: Base delta support [-300,3840] seconds, extended using the observed incoming residual and the fixed training-noise extrema plus nine kernel standard deviations. Exact anchor is included. Prior cell masses are Cauchy CDF differences. Likelihood and outgoing CDF use one-second tables. Outside-support unnormalized likelihood mass is bounded using the Gaussian nine-sigma density. Grid evidence is numerical, so its ratio is a diagnostic rather than a certified posterior bound.
local_joint_assumption: Given delta and route roles, centered incoming/outgoing noises are independent with the earlier KDE laws. The predictor conditions only on the rider-known incoming arrival. Arbitrary route-specific day loadings, serial day drift, and selection on unobserved outcomes are outside this local joint law. Canceled service remains a separate earlier route marginal.
